faults.trigger: a summary whose mean and per-seed accuracies contradict the metrics files, given to the numbers recheck
invariants: a fail or uncertain is recorded as it is
a fail opens the matching obligations once; delivering it again or restarting adds none
a corrected result and a new passing review close them only by an explicit resolution

faults.trigger: the hypothesis' literature lacks Polyak 1964; the brief does not add it
invariants: a NEEDS_EVIDENCE/uncertain with requested_queries leads to one literature_followup and a follow-up round in the same session
a completed query is not run again after a restart
a reviewer that settles it from the material is not forced to ask

faults.trigger: set to the Leader's own family
invariants: the review is refused before any model call

faults.target: the reviewer backend on the session's PATH
faults.trigger: a shim that answers 'not logged in' for one session
invariants: REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE, no other backend, no self-review
after the PATH is restored a real cross-family review is registered once

faults.trigger: methods.py in the snapshot altered (not the reviewed commit's)
invariants: after the real snapshot is restored the receipt matches the code, configuration and claim
